items.title: Sudhalter interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: And he’s going to be coming over here so I’m going to try and work out some clubs for us together

ctx.x: Anything coming up in the near future that you’re looking forward to?

Well you know I have my new CD, that, it was a live concert here in New York at St. Peter’s that came out real good, on baritone and flute and I sang for the first time, I sang one of my own tunes. And I just went to Italy to promote that and the gigs I did there were to promote that CD, because it just came out, and actually the release date here is officially January 18 so it’s not even yet. And so what I plan to do is organize as many gigs and tours around that as I possibly can. Because I think it’s a good…
I’m going to approach Mezzrow and see. Because he’s a very high quality player and we want to try to do this together. So I hope that this year will be, I think it probably will be a fruitful year.
